subject: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal

Hi Samir — great talking earlier. Per our conversation, I sketched an amendment that accomplishes three goals: (1) move to a 24-month term to lock predictable unit pricing, (2) provide an escrowed onramp (credits you can draw against) to ease initial spikes, and (3) allow a limited usage-swing window to handle quarterly product launches without immediate overage charges.

High-level proposal (attachment: NovaPulse_Renewal_Amendment_v1.pdf):
- Term: 24 months, start date 2028-08-01.
- Commit: Year 1: 2.1M token units (60% of target); Year 2: 3.5M token units (100% target) — reconciled by true-up each quarter.
- Escrowed onramp: $50k credit held and released against overages in Q1 only; remaining balance applies to Year 1 usage if not consumed.
- Usage-swing: two 30-day swing windows per year where overages are billed at a capped uplift (list price + 10%) instead of standard overage rate.
- Auto-renew: opt-in at 12 months with 60-day notice; otherwise manual renewal.

I attached an example escrow schedule (Escrow_Onramp_Schedule.xlsx) and a DocuSign link will be ready after we lock numbers. Can you confirm if the Year 1/Year 2 split and the swing windows work for NovaPulse's launch cadence? If yes, I’ll send a clean amendment for signature and loop in Procurement.

Thanks — Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@novapulse.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novapulse.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal

Mateo — thanks for the recap and the draft. We like the escrow idea; it gives our product team runway for the July launch. A couple of clarifying items:
1) Can the escrow be applied to Year 2 if not used in Year 1? We may have a quieter Q1 and heavy Q2.
2) For the swing windows, can we have one of the windows tied to a specific product launch date (we can provide tentative dates)?
3) Pricing on Year 2 — is the 3.5M commitment fixed price or blended usage?

Procurement: I’m looped — they’ll need the DocuSign and a redline-friendly PDF.

— Samir
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: ask on escrow mechanics + billing cadence

Internal note — Samir's asks look reasonable. A few operational points we should confirm before sending the next revision: 
- Escrow rollover: legal usually allows rollover to Year 2 only if both parties agree in amendment language; we can draft a conditional rollover clause ("unused escrow credited to Year 2 subject to mutual written consent").
- Billing cadence: keep quarterly true-up with invoices net 30. That keeps finance teams aligned.
- Swing window tie to launch: operationally we can reserve one window per 12 months that must be scheduled 30 days in advance.

I recommend we propose: conditional rollover + quarterly true-up + one pre-scheduled swing window per year. Priyom, can you confirm margin impact if we cap overage uplift at +10% instead of standard +25%?

Thanks — Camila
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal

Samir — quick update and answers inline: 

> Can the escrow be applied to Year 2 if not used in Year 1?
Yes — we can include a conditional rollover clause. I added language: "Unused escrow credits may be applied to Year 2 upon mutual written consent and subject to a cap of 50% of Year 2's quarterly commitment." (see attached v1).

> For the swing windows, can one be tied to a launch date?
Yes — we’ll include an operational schedule: one pre-booked 30-day swing window per 12 months with a minimum 30-day notice. The second window remains flexible.

> Pricing on Year 2 — fixed or blended?
Year 2 pricing stays fixed for the committed units (3.5M). Any consumption above the committed units during non-swing periods is billed at the standard overage. During swing windows overage is capped at +10% uplift.

Next steps: if that aligns I’ll prepare a clean amendment and a DocuSign envelope. I’m marking the DocuSign to route first to Procure for signature and then to Samir.

Attachment: NovaPulse_Renewal_Amendment_v1.pdf (clean v1 with conditional rollover language)

— Mateo
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novapulse.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal

Hi Mateo / Camila — procurement here. We reviewed the PDF. A few redline items before legal: 
- Please add a 45-day termination-for-convenience notice (we need an option at the 12-month mark).
- Confirm whether unused escrow can be returned rather than rolled (we need a default return if no written consent).
- Include invoice header: NovaPulse, Inc. / Tax ID: 12-3456789 / Bill-to: 100 Market St, SF CA 94105.

If you can send a redline-friendly (Word) version and the DocuSign after we agree on default return language, we can turn it around quickly.

Thanks — Procurement
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novapulse.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escrowed onramp + usage-swing amendment — NovaPulse renewal

Procurement / Samir — quick finance/legal confirmation from our side: 
- Margin impact of capped +10% swing uplift: acceptable if escrow default return is allowed; otherwise, we need a partial protection clause (we propose a 6-month review after Year 1 to reassess uplift cap).
- Default for unused escrow: we can add a return clause: "If not consumed and no mutual written consent to roll, unused escrow will be returned to NovaPulse within 60 days of Year 1 close."
- Termination-for-convenience: 45-day option at 12 months is acceptable to Redwood, provided the customer repays any consumed escrow and outstanding true-up amounts pro-rated.

If that works, Mateo — please produce a redline-friendly doc and I’ll approve the final DocuSign envelope.

— Priyom
